title: S--Friant Dam Janitorial Services
description: The purpose of this Sources Sought (SS) announcement is to gain knowledge of potentially qualified businesses that are capable of providing all labor, materials, equipment, cleaning supplies, transportation and supervision necessary to provide the janitorial services at Bureau of Reclamation¿s (BOR) South Central California Area Office (SCCAO) Friant Dam Field Office.  The Contractor¿s primary base of operations will be located at the Friant Dam Field Office:  18015 Friant Road Friant, CA 93626  This notice is being issued to help determine the availability of qualified businesses technically capable of meeting the Government requirements and to determine the method of acquisition.  The Government intends to award a Firm Fixed Price (FFP) type of contract.   This SS is issued solely for information and planning purposes and does not constitute a Request for Quote (RFQ).  Respondents are solely responsible for all expenses associated with responding to the SS.  Information received from this SS may be utilized in preparing potential solicitation documentation.  It is the contractor¿s responsibility to identify proprietary information in response to this notice.   This notice is not to be construed as a commitment by the Government to issue a solicitation or ultimately award a contract. Responses will not be considered as proposals or quotes. No award will be made as a result of this notice.  NAICS Code: 561720 ¿ Janitorial Services  Size Standard: $22 million  Responses Due Date: December 1, 2026 at 11am Pacific Standard Time (PST)  Submission: Via email to erma_clark@ios.doi.gov. ALL documents must be in .pdf format.  Potential vendors shall provide the following information at a minimum to be considered a viable source:  1. Business Size & Classification(s) 2. Contact Information (Name, Phone, email & website (If Applicable)) 3. UEI number and/or CAGE code 4. Capabilities Statement 5. Appropriate document that demonstrates capabilities to provide the services needed.  * If any of the required information, items 1 through 5, are not submitted in its entirety by the response date, the vendor will be considered incapable of providing the required services and shall not be considered a viable source for market research purposes.  Notice Number 140RR027Q0054 has been assigned and should be referenced on all correspondence regarding this announcement.  See attached Performance Work Statement (PWS) for additional details.
